mapper.select: select dataset_id datasetId, dataset_name datasetName, dataset_version datasetVersion, description, status, create_by createBy, create_time createTime from expert_eval_dataset where status = 'ACTIVE' order by dataset_id

select case_id caseId, dataset_id datasetId, user_id userId, case_name caseName, gold_fields_json goldFieldsJson, gold_entities_json goldEntitiesJson, gold_relations_json goldRelationsJson, gold_conflicts_json goldConflictsJson, notes, create_time createTime from expert_eval_case where dataset_id = #{datasetId} order by case_id
mapper.insert: insert into expert_eval_run (dataset_id, run_status, case_count, create_by, create_time, update_time) values (#{datasetId}, 'RUNNING', #{caseCount}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), sysdate())
mapper.update: update expert_eval_run set run_status = #{runStatus}, case_count = #{caseCount}, metrics_json = #{metricsJson}, report_json = #{reportJson}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_time = sysdate() where run_id = #{runId}
mapper.insert: insert into expert_eval_case_result (run_id, case_id, user_id, metrics_json, detail_json, create_time) values (#{runId}, #{caseId}, #{userId}, #{metricsJson}, #{detailJson}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select run_id runId, dataset_id datasetId, run_status runStatus, case_count caseCount, metrics_json metricsJson, report_json reportJson, error_message errorMessage, create_by createBy, create_time createTime, update_time updateTime from expert_eval_run where run_id = #{runId}

select result_id resultId, run_id runId, case_id caseId, user_id userId, metrics_json metricsJson, detail_json detailJson, create_time createTime from expert_eval_case_result where run_id = #{runId} order by result_id
